acceptanceCriteria: The stale path is removed or the file restored, with the reason recorded.
A doc gate (or the specindex test) refuses an INDEX.json implementation path that is absent from the tree, with one maintained test.
body: Observed 2026-10-13 on origin/main d72617c4 during V1-1278 S3: docs/specs/INDEX.json line ~1580 lists tools/gate-affected-select/readers.go under the gate-ledger-v0 implementation list, but the tree holds only main.go and main_test.go there. No doc gate catches an implementation path that does not exist. Expected: INDEX.json implementation lists name existing paths and a gate refuses stale ones. Actual: stale path retained silently. Confirmed by git ls-tree origin/main tools/gate-affected-select/.
title: docs/specs/INDEX.json gate-ledger-v0 implementation list names a missing file tools/gate-affected-select/readers.go
